tenderSchedule.title: Tender for the maintenance of 07Nos public toilets in the Karnataka Exhibition Authority premises during the 2026 Dasara Exhibition.
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for the maintenance of 07Nos public toilets in the Karnataka Exhibition Authority premises during the 2026 Dasara Exhibition.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: DD / Pay order for Rs.1,00,000 (Rs. One lakhs only)being of the tender amount. The DD /Pay order to be drawn from scheduled Commercial Bank/ Nationalised Bank and in favour of CEO, KEA, Mysuru. Scanned copy of the DD / Pay order need to be uploaded in e-portal. Original DD / Pay order has to be submitted to KEA through registered post with a/d or in person so as to reach the Authority on or before the date of opening the technical proposal.
